_readme: Evidence for Fish Audio's text-to-speech line.
One capability here is genuinely production-shaped and worth carrying into the
catalogue even though nothing dispatches: MULTI-SPEAKER in a single request, with
speaker tags inline in the text. A scene of dialogue generated as one take is a
different artefact from two takes stitched together, and no other audio model in this
Note the discipline about emotion markers. Fish Audio's S1 announcement describes
emotion markers like (angry) and (in a hurry). The S2 API reference documents none.
Those are two different models and the claim is not carried across.

capabilities.claim: Zero-shot voice cloning from a reference id or an inline references array.
Multi-speaker generation in one request, on the S2 family, via inline speaker tags.
Temperature and top_p are caller parameters.
A latency dial with named levels.

capabilities.note: Seconds of clear speech with minimal background noise.

notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: constraints.maxPromptCharacters is null. No documented limit is not the same as no limit, and this is recorded as a caveat rather than treated as unlimited.

notEstablished.claim: Emotion markers on the S2 family.
notEstablished.status: described in the vendor's S1 announcement; NOT documented in the S2 API reference
